links.comparator_used: LLM-based CDSS alone and pharmacist alone (no LLM)
links.outcome: Accuracy of detecting prescribing errors in medication chart review scenarios, including errors posing serious harm
links.effect: Co-pilot (pharmacist plus LLM-based CDSS) accuracy 61% (precision 0.57, recall 0.61, F1 0.59), the best of the three arms; for errors posing serious harm, accuracy was 1.5-fold higher than pharmacist alone
links.quote: The co-pilot arm demonstrated the best performance with an accuracy of 61% (precision 0.57, recall 0.61, and F1 0.59).

design_hint: human-in-the-loop co-pilot vs solo AI or clinician
